title: Yackandandah, VIC - Infrastructure Restoration
current_summary: An upstream access network incident affected services in Yackandandah, VIC. Services were restored at 10:07 AM AEST on 3 July 2026. We are monitoring and no further impact is expected.

updates.content: Services in Yackandandah, VIC were affected by an upstream access network issue. All services were restored at 10:07 AM AEST on 3 July 2026. If your connection is still offline, please restart your modem or router and contact our support team. We’re monitoring and appreciate your patience.
